# hCaptcha
> Enterprise-grade AI security platform focused on stopping bots and human abuse while preserving user privacy.

hCaptcha provides bot detection, account defense, risk scoring, passive and interactive challenges, and privacy-focused alternatives to reCAPTCHA for web and mobile applications. Its site includes product information, developer documentation, API references, migration guides, accessibility resources, and company/legal materials.

## Product
- [Homepage](https://www.hcaptcha.com/): Overview of hCaptcha’s privacy-focused bot protection and abuse prevention platform.
- [Signup](https://www.hcaptcha.com/signup-interstitial): Entry point for creating an hCaptcha account and selecting a plan.
- [Pricing](https://www.hcaptcha.com/pricing): Compare Free, Pro, and Enterprise plans and feature availability.
- [Contact Sales](https://www.hcaptcha.com/contact-us): Reach the sales team for enterprise evaluation and deployment support.
- [Accessibility](https://www.hcaptcha.com/accessibility): Accessibility approach, accommodations, and usability information for hCaptcha challenges.
- [Press](https://www.hcaptcha.com/press): Company announcements, media resources, and press-related information.

## Documentation
- [Docs Home](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Main documentation portal for integration, configuration, and product capabilities.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Introductory documentation for adding hCaptcha to applications and services.
- [Configuration](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/configuration/): Client-side widget configuration options, parameters, and behavior controls.
- [Server](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Server-side verification concepts and implementation guidance.
- [Enterprise](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/enterprise/): Enterprise-specific features, controls, and deployment documentation.
- [Accessibility Challenge](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/accessibility/): Documentation for accessibility support and challenge experience considerations.

## API Reference
- [Verify API](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Reference for server-side token verification and validation workflow.
- [Siteverify Endpoint](https://api.hcaptcha.com/siteverify): Verification endpoint for validating hCaptcha response tokens.
- [JavaScript API](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/configuration/): Widget rendering, callbacks, and client-side integration parameters.
- [Enterprise APIs](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/enterprise/): Enterprise API capabilities for risk analysis and advanced security workflows.
- [Error Codes](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Common verification and integration errors with troubleshooting guidance.

## Integration Guides
- [Add hCaptcha to Your Site](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Core guide for embedding hCaptcha on web forms and flows.
- [Invisible hCaptcha](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/invisible/): Configure low-friction or invisible challenge flows for supported use cases.
- [Content Security Policy](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Guidance for CSP configuration required by hCaptcha assets and endpoints.
- [Localhost Testing](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Recommendations for development, staging, and local integration testing.
- [Mobile App Integration](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Guidance for integrating hCaptcha into native and mobile web applications.
- [Custom Themes and Sizing](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/configuration/): Options for appearance, size, and user experience customization.

## Migration
- [Migrate from reCAPTCHA](https://www.hcaptcha.com/recaptcha): Overview of replacing reCAPTCHA with hCaptcha using minimal code changes.
- [reCAPTCHA Compatibility](https://docs.hcaptcha.com/): Notes on API compatibility and migration considerations.
- [Switch with Two Lines of Code](https://www.hcaptcha.com/recaptcha): Product page describing simple migration from Google reCAPTCHA.
- [Enterprise Migration Support](https://www.hcaptcha.com/contact-us): Contact sales for migration planning and enterprise rollout assistance.

## Solutions
- [Bot Protection](https://www.hcaptcha.com/): Protect signup, login, checkout, and other flows from automated abuse.
- [Account Defense](https://www.hcaptcha.com/): Reduce credential stuffing, account takeover, and scripted login attacks.
- [Payments and Checkout Protection](https://www.hcaptcha.com/): Defend commerce flows from fraud, abuse, and automated exploitation.
- [Signup and Registration Security](https://www.hcaptcha.com/): Stop fake account creation and abuse during onboarding flows.
- [MFA Alternative](https://www.hcaptcha.com/): Privacy-preserving authentication support positioned as an alternative to SMS-based MFA.
- [Global Compliance and Reach](https://www.hcaptcha.com/): Product positioning around privacy, compliance, and worldwide availability.
